text_summary.body: In the eighth month of Darius's second year the word came to Zechariah son of Berechiah, son of Iddo: the LORD was very angry with your fathers; return to me and I will return to you; do not be like your fathers, who did not listen to the former prophets; my words overtook them, and they repented.

setting.body: Two months after Haggai's first oracle and a few weeks after his oracle of 21/VII; the Temple work had resumed on 24/VI.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4VKPC23E13MFWG57MHGXF4E
constraints.textual_assertion: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius
assumptions: Babylonian Nisan-based regnal years: year 2 = 3 April 520 – 22 March 519 (Parker & Dubberstein). The eighth month fell in October–November 520.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4VKPC23E13MFWG57MHGXF4E

constraints.subject: evt_01M4VKPC23E13MFWG57MHGXF4E
constraints.textual_assertion: eighth month, before Haggai's oracles of 24/IX

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik dates the oracle to October–November 520 and stresses the call to repentance before rebuilding.

open_questions: Zechariah is "son of Berechiah, son of Iddo" here but "son of Iddo" in Ezra 5:1 and 6:14 (grandson called son, or a conflation). Matt 23:35 names "Zechariah son of Barachiah" in a different context (cf. 2 Chr 24:20–21).

not_applicable.locations: Jerusalem implied; no location research needed.
not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: The oracle is undisputed; its date follows the superscription.
